ingestion_schedule.initial_run: immediately at actual process start time, to the second
ingestion_schedule.missed_boundaries: skip; do not overlap or invent historical realtime samples

bronze.body_format: exact HTTPX decoded response bytes, before JSON parsing
bronze.publication_authority: MySQL collection_runs status and finished_at; filesystem completion alone is insufficient
bronze.retention: retain all local raw; no automatic local deletion

github_actions.storage: one artifact per GitHub workflow run and attempt, uploaded after the collector
github_actions.backup_required: download before artifact expiry; preserve all referenced historical weather captures
github_actions.locator: github_collection.json maps GitHub run/attempt to relative manifest paths
github_actions.failure_boundary: Silver commit and artifact upload are not atomic; upload failure can leave Silver without remotely saved raw

silver.storage: existing MySQL database; no table rename

weather_observations.role: normalized weather with original units and interval

rules: exclude inactive and stale from normal availability metrics
metadata is mutable; historical metadata reconstruction uses Bronze

gold.storage: existing MySQL database; additive Gold tables separate from Silver
gold.input: completed Silver runs and usable observations; no API calls from Gold workers
rules: features must be known by input cutoff
store UTC window bounds and use New York timezone for local calendar features
insufficient data produces a status, not fabricated metrics or predictions

analysis_results.publication: atomic upsert of changed materialized metrics and service_run completion; only completed success runs are published
analysis_results.history: current materialized value per key, not immutable point-in-time snapshots; no automatic deletion

clustering_runs.cadence: once per New York calendar day
clustering_runs.publication: immutable successful daily snapshot; atomic memberships and service completion; insufficient_data has no memberships

predictions.input_time_policy: target_at = bike.sampled_at + 1800 seconds; input_cutoff and issued_at stored separately
predictions.quality_policy: valid fresh installed/renting only; otherwise unavailable and NULL value

model_versions.storage: portable JSON trees in MySQL; no pickle or runner-local model dependency
model_versions.selection: validation MAE strictly beats persistence, then holdout evaluation, then production refit

training_jobs.cadence: explicit only; never inside prediction loop

analysis_configuration.cadence_note: Expected collection cadence remains separate from worker cadence; historical cadence changes require an explicit policy.

clustering_configuration.algorithm: StandardScaler+KMeans; silhouette selection; no singleton groups
clustering_configuration.capacity_policy: current metadata snapshot; not historical capacity reconstruction

prediction_configuration.missing_policy: no imputation; explicit baseline fallback or unavailable
prediction_configuration.collection_cadence_note: collector remains 1800 seconds; unavailable periods are expected after input age exceeds 600 seconds
